description: Window controls (drag / minimize / close) for profile-link windows (the New Window link target, label glob profile-*) showing the remote engine.tfd.rocks page. Mirrors monitor.json's least-privilege posture: grants ONLY window manipulation — no file, bridge, store, dialog, or app commands — so a profile page can manage its own window but cannot reach anything sensitive. The profile-* label glob keeps these dynamic remote windows OUT of the local 'default' capability (which is scoped to 'main' only).
